system.name: Hit locations
system.hint: Grand Unified Hit Locations (v2.4): sub-tables, called shots, armor gaps and wounding by location, with one location per hit on the hit-location card. Standard: upstream's table for the target's body plan (still one location per hit, and cover). Non-humanoid body plans always use their own table.

torsoCap.name: Torso injury cap
torsoCap.hint: GUHL: injury from one chest or abdomen hit can't exceed 2×HP (1×HP when using bleeding rules); any excess is lost.

facing.name: Token facing at rotation 0
facing.hint: Which way token art faces when not rotated. Used to tell whether an attack comes from the target's front, side or rear arc (spine and skull/face from behind, nose and jaw only from the front). The GM can override it on each hit-location card.

desc.crCutImpPiTb: cr, cut, imp, pi, tb burn only
desc.crCutPiTb: cr, cut, pi, tb burn only

note.armorVisor: Covered by spectacles, a visor or a full helm.
note.noseToSkull: Impaling, piercing and tight-beam burning go through the nose: a skull hit.
note.earAsFace: Only cutting attacks count as an ear hit: treated as a face hit.
note.eyesAsFace: Only impaling, piercing and tight-beam burning reach the eye: treated as a face hit.
note.invalidType: That called shot isn't allowed for this damage type.
note.invalidFacing: That called shot isn't possible from this side.
note.armorGap: Armor gap: the armor's DR doesn't count (innate DR does).
note.armpitCritical: On a critical hit: also cripples the arm, instead of rolling on the critical hit table.
note.insideThighVein: Optional rule in use: cutting, impaling, piercing and tight-beam burning hit the vein/artery.
note.skullShock: Any injury that causes shock: knockdown/stun roll. Major wound: knockdown roll at -10.
note.skullDR: The skull's +2 DR is assumed to be in the body plan's skull DR (GCS includes it).
note.eyeSkull: Otherwise a skull hit, without the skull's DR.
note.eyeTox: Toxic: no special effect beyond crippling.
note.faceShock: Any injury that causes shock: knockdown/stun roll. Major wound: knockdown roll at -5.
note.jawShock: Any injury that causes shock: knockdown/stun roll at -1. Major wound: at -6.
note.noseCut: Cutting: crippling costs Appearance (crippling threshold doubled).
note.noseCrush: Crippled: No Sense of Smell/Taste. Major wound: knockdown roll at -5.
note.earCripple: Cripple over HP/4; no -5 to knockdown; major wound only if severed; a lost ear costs Appearance.
note.neckWindpipe: Optional: crushing injury over HP/2 crushes the windpipe (crippled, choking).
note.spineShock: Enough injury for a shock penalty (even with High Pain Threshold): knockdown/stun roll, at -5 for a major wound.
note.spineCripple: Cripple over HP: Bad Back (Severe) and Lame (Paraplegic) until healed.
note.torsoCap: Injury can't exceed {cap}×HP; any excess is lost.
note.digestiveMajor: Major wound: HT-3 to avoid special effects.
note.pelvisMajor: Major wound: falls down and can't stand; Lame (Missing Legs) until healed.
note.groinShock: Double shock. Major wound: knockdown roll at -5.
note.vitalsCrush: Crushing: shock-force HT roll for knockdown.
note.heartSpecial: The heart may be special for some characters (vampires).
note.jointLimb: Joint: cripple over HP/3; dismember as a limb; recover from crippling at -2.
note.jointExtremity: Joint: cripple over HP/4; dismember as an extremity; recover from crippling at -2.
note.veinLimb: Vein/artery: no crippling and no injury limit.
note.bleedFast: Bleeding rolls every 30 seconds, not every minute.

card.title: {attacker} hits {target}
card.coverMissed: Half covered: 1d6 {roll}, the exposed half is hit.

invalid.type: {target} can't be targeted with this damage type: resolved as shown.
invalid.facing: {target} can't be targeted from this side: resolved as shown.

card.noBodyLocation: Not on the target's body plan: uses the torso.

dialog.title: Cover: {name}
dialog.hpHint: Leave blank to not track HP. Damage that gets through the cover's DR also comes off its HP; at 0 HP it no longer protects.
dialog.customHint: Used when Cover is Custom. Low wall: legs, feet, abdomen. Chest-high: everything below the neck. Firing over cover: only the head, neck, arms and hands are exposed. Corner: that side's limbs and half the torso. Half-covered parts: each random hit there rolls 1d6, 1-3 hits the cover; a called shot hits the exposed half.

warn.coverHpNoGM: No GM is online to update the cover's HP.
warn.noTarget: Can't find the target of this hit.

info.missByOne: Missed the {from} by 1: hits the {to} instead.
